newsitem.title: UK: Pru seeks to salvage NatWest talks -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Pru seeks to salvage NatWest talks -- paper.

text.p: Britain's insurance group Prudential Corp Plc has launched a lobbying campaign among institutional investors to revive merger negotiations with National Westminster Bank, the Sunday Times reported.
Talks collapsed in their early stages last week, but Prudential hopes NatWest's investors will press the bank to return to the negotiating table, the newspaper said.

No one at Prudential was available to comment, while NatWest declined to react. The Observer, another British weekly newspaper, said NatWest had called off the talks after deciding a merger would not be the best option for shareholders.
A link-up would create a financial services giant with a market capitalisation of about 27 billion pounds.
NatWest earlier this year approached Abbey National Plc to discuss a merger, but was rebuffed.
